headline: Agricultural Funds Retreat as Wheat and Soybean ETFs Drop Over 0.7%
summary: The WEAT wheat ETF declined 1.03% and the SOYB soybean fund fell 0.76%. Major agribusiness traders Archer-Daniels-Midland and Bunge slipped 1.24% and 0.55%, respectively, while corn finished nearly flat.
why: Grains and oilseeds trade underpins global food processing margins, feed supplies, and large multinational agricultural trading revenues.

impacts.name: Archer-Daniels-Midland Company
impacts.why: Declining grain fund valuations and softer crop prices weighed on agricultural merchant shares.
